title: Classical Syndrome Measurement Readout Bit-Flip Damping and Parity-Check Verification
claims: Independent readout bit-flip error eta in [0, 1/2] on a CNOT syndrome wire damps Pauli-X sign-rectified visibility by (1 - 2*eta) per pair and (1 - 2*eta)^2 across two Stage-2 pairs.
Adding a 1-ancilla parity-check verification readout and post-selecting on agreement reduces the effective readout error rate to eta_post = eta^2 / ((1 - eta)^2 + eta^2) = O(eta^2).
favorable_controls: Realistic eta=0.05 readout error (18.1x suppression to eta_post = 0.002762)
